content:
Hi all — I’m preparing what would be my first mathlib PR, and I’d appreciate some advice on file placement / naming.

Starting from IsCommJordan, I formalized a standard first linearization of the commutative Jordan identity using associator:

  • This is the standard first linearization of the commutative Jordan identity, as in McCrimmon, A Taste of Jordan Algebras, Proposition 1.8.5
  • This is a version valid without extra characteristic assumptions,
  • And there is a simplified version assuming IsSMulRegular A 2.

The proofs are local and stable, and this seems like a natural API extension for later Jordan-algebra calculations.

Before opening a PR, I wanted to ask:

  1. would this be better placed in Mathlib/Algebra/Jordan/Basic.lean, or in a new file such as Mathlib/Algebra/Jordan/Linearization.lean?
  2. do the theorem names
    IsCommJordan.four_nsmul_associator_mul_add
    and
    IsCommJordan.associator_mul_add
    seem reasonable, or is there a naming style you’d prefer?

Thanks!
I think these sorts of questions are precisely the questions answered during a standard PR review.
